completeness.description: Whether this graph is a COMPLETE search. Determinism guarantee: two runs over the same live data agree; when a transient failure (rate limit, timeout) or a bounded cap makes a run partial, it is reported here rather than silently producing a smaller graph.

complete.description: True only when discovery, citations, and the seminal index all completed without dropped requests or truncation.

warnings.description: Deterministic, human-readable list of everything that made the run partial.

discovery.description: Sourcegraph dependent-search completeness (truncation / abandoned / interrupted streams).

citations.description: Per-node citation completeness; incompleteNodes lists repos whose paper search was partial.

seminalIndex.description: JOSS seminal-DOI index load status (jossPagesFailed > 0 can hide seminal papers).

confidence.description: Discovery confidence tier: high | medium | low | unknown

evidence.description: Map of evidence type (vcs_ref, cmake_target, find_package, bazel, pkg_config, pragma_lib, include, custom) to number of matching lines observed.

identifiers.description: Provider identifier values (header names, package names, ...) this consumer was observed referencing.

provenance.description: How the matched identifiers were learned (include_tree, cmake_config, cmake_project, pc_file, bazel_module, vcs, convention, ...).

evidenceLayer.description: Strongest Axis-A evidence layer observed for this edge: 1 narrative, 2 source-consumption, 3 build-manifest, 4 package-registry, 5 binary/link, 6 attestation/SBOM, 7 bibliometric.

layers.description: All distinct Axis-A evidence layers observed for this edge (sorted). Cross-layer corroboration drives confidence.

relationship.description: Edge relationship: DEPENDS_ON | VENDORED (reproduces most of the provider's headers) | MIRROR (GitHub fork).

citationDepth.description: Hops from a seminal DOI in the reverse-citation crawl: 0 = seminal (the repo's own paper) or a direct text/full-text seed hit, 1 = direct citer, 2+ = citer-of-citer.

concepts.description: OpenAlex concepts/topics (+ Crossref subjects) for the work.

provenance.description: Discovery channels that surfaced this DOI; strongest relevance signal.

relevanceTier.description: Relevance band from relevanceScore. Low-tier citing papers are dropped by default (see --no-paper-filter).

relevanceEvidence.description: Per-signal breakdown: provenance, sharedAuthors, matchedTerms, matchedConcepts, venue, channels, and optional llm verdict.

paperDiagnostics.description: Completeness of THIS node's citation search. complete=false means a rate limit / timeout / cap dropped data, so the papers list may differ on another run.

httpFailures.description: Per-channel (openalex, opencitations, crossref) counts of dropped requests by kind (rate_limited, server_error, request_error, bad_response).

doisUnresolved.description: DOIs that resolved to no metadata at all (dropped for lack of data, not low relevance).
